interpretation_contract.binary: UP and DOWN are both explicit complements; TP/FP/TN/FN and balanced accuracy are valid binary direction diagnostics.
interpretation_contract.ternary: Only +1 and -1 are explicit direction calls; neutral is not silently converted to DOWN. Full-timeline class recalls count neutral as missed direction.
interpretation_contract.up_only: NOT-UP is abstention/context, never positive DOWN. Only UP precision/recall/FPR are reported.
